embeds.title: FRANCHISE OWNERSHIP & ROLES
embeds.description: Discord roles reflect league function. They are not extra votes or extra franchises.

fields.name: 🏒 FRANCHISE OWNER
fields.value: Primary owner role. Full league participation and the franchise's formal league vote.

fields.name: 🤝 CO-OWNER
fields.value: Full team-management and community access. Co-owners do **not** create a second league vote.

fields.name: ⚜️ FOUNDING OWNER
fields.value: Permanent recognition for original BLHA ownership.

fields.name: 🏆 / 🥇 HONOR ROLES
fields.value: League Champion and Presidents' Trophy roles recognize current title holders.

fields.name: 🗳️ FORMAL VOTING
fields.value: Only the Franchise Owner role posts the franchise's vote in **league-voting**. Co-owners can view the channel but remain read-only by design.

footer.text: ONE FRANCHISE • ONE VOTE • ONE DUES OBLIGATION
